info.title: API.SH: Civitai
info.description: The Civitai API from API.SH: public Civitai data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Creators on Civitai matching a name: username, model count, avatar and profile link. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/civitai-creators

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Part of a username.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Creators per page (1-200, default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Images posted on Civitai, newest or most reacted first, filtered by model, model version, post or creator: image link, size, creator, base model, reactions and comments, and the generation data the creator shared (prompt, sampler, steps, seed, resources used). PG-rated images only by default; `include_nsfw=true` returns every rating (or up to `nsfw_level`), each with its rating. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/civitai-images

parameters.description: Model id.

parameters.name: model_version_id
parameters.description: Model version id.

parameters.name: post_id
parameters.description: Post id.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Creator username.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Most Reactions, Most Comments, Most Collected, Newest, Oldest, Random or Recently Added.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Day, Week, Month, Year or AllTime.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Images per page (1-100, default 50).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page.

parameters.name: include_nsfw
parameters.description: Opt in to adult content: `true` also returns adult models and images, each with its content rating (`nsfw`, `nsfw_level`). Default off.

parameters.name: nsfw_level
parameters.description: With `include_nsfw=true`: the content rating filter the site applies (None, Soft, Mature, X; default X = every rating).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Civitai model: name, type, description, creator, tags, stats, licence terms, and every version (base model, trigger words, files with size, format, hashes, scan results and download link, PG-rated sample images). Adult models answer 404 unless `include_nsfw=true` (then with all sample images and their content ratings).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/civitai-model

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Model id or a civitai.com/models/<id> link.

parameters.name: include_nsfw
parameters.description: Opt in to adult content: `true` also returns adult models and images, each with its content rating (`nsfw`, `nsfw_level`). Default off.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
AI models on Civitai (checkpoints, LoRAs, embeddings, ControlNets, VAEs, workflows...) matching a keyword, tag or creator, with every filter the site takes: types, base models, sort, period and licence flags. Each model: id, name, type, description, creator, tags, stats (downloads, likes, comments, tips), licence terms and every version with its base model, trigger words, files (size, format, hashes, scan results, download link) and PG-rated sample images. Safe-for-work by default: adult models and images are left out unless `include_nsfw=true`. Up to 10 a page; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/civitai-models

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Keywords (model name).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: A tag, e.g. character or style.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Creator username.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: One or more model types, comma-separated.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Hot, Highest Rated, Most Downloaded, Most Liked, Most Discussed, Most Collected, Most Images, Newest, Oldest or Recently Added.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Day, Week, Month, Year or AllTime (for the sort).

parameters.name: base_models
parameters.description: Base models, comma-separated (e.g. SDXL 1.0, Pony, Flux.1 D, SD 1.5).

parameters.name: allow_commercial_use
parameters.description: None, Image, RentCivit, Rent, Sell or SellMerge (comma-separated).

parameters.name: allow_no_credit
parameters.description: true/false: use without crediting the creator.

parameters.name: allow_derivatives
parameters.description: true/false: merges and derivatives allowed.

parameters.name: allow_different_licenses
parameters.description: true/false: derivatives may use another licence.

parameters.name: supports_generation
parameters.description: true/false: can be run on the site's generator.

parameters.name: primary_file_only
parameters.description: true: only each version's primary file.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Model ids, comma-separated.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Models per page (1-10, default 10).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page.

parameters.name: include_nsfw
parameters.description: Opt in to adult content: `true` also returns adult models and images, each with its content rating (`nsfw`, `nsfw_level`). Default off.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Model tags on Civitai matching a word, each with a link to its models. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/civitai-tags

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Part of a tag.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Tags per page (1-200, default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
